title: Porsha Riley (Western Governors University · operations manager) — starts a 4-week Corporate Strategy Externship on the Incorruptible framework
summary: Riley is studying business management at Western Governors University and works as an operations manager for a transportation company. She has started the four-week Corporate Strategy Externship mentored by Eric Ries, working through the Incorruptible framework to recognise mission drift and evaluate business strategies.
attribution_title: Western Governors University · Business Management · Operations Manager
blockquote: Throughout this four-week experience, I will be exploring The Incorruptible Framework, learning how to identify organizational challenges, recognize mission drift, evaluate business strategies, and develop actionable plans to help companies remain aligned with their mission and long-term vision.
